contexts.text: Like one scoured and washed with water.
In passing to the internal sense, the idea of idolatry... is banished.
Pleasures from cupidities must be restrained and banished.
With the good... the evil is successively wiped away.
Circumcision... = the removal and wiping off of the things that impeded... heavenly love.
Not the least bit of the evil which a man has thought and actually done... is wiped away, or blotted out... AC 2694:4. AC 4295:2. AC 4721:2. AC 5398.
When the things of the light of the world are obliterated or wiped out...
(The notion that) evils will be wiped away (on the death-bed) by a confession... of the wiping away of sins by His passion... AC 7317:2.

Truth is falsified when it is said that sins are wiped out and washed away as dirt is with water; and it is still more falsified when it is said that... when sins have been remitted by a man they are completely wiped out...
(Most good Spirits) remain for some time beneath Heaven, in order that the things of earthly and bodily loves... may be wiped off. AE 413.
How falsely those think who believe that the evils or sins in a man are wiped off, as dirt is washed off...

Believes that sins are wiped away when they are said to be remitted. This belief comes from the literal sense... where it is sometimes so said... (the truth being that man is only) withheld from sins... AC 9451. NJHD 166. DP 279:2. AE 478.

God shall wipe away every tear from their eyes () = that they shall no longer be in combats... Illustrated. ( = a state of bliss from the affection of truth, after falsities have been removed by temptations. For to wipe away the tear from the eyes = to take away grief of mind... AE 484.) AR 884. TCR 126:end.
The Lord remits the sins of all... but still they are not thereby wiped away; for they are wiped away only by repentance.
Merit is easily wiped away by the Lord from those who imbue charity...
(Thus) the remission of sins is not their extirpation and wiping out, but their removal...
After their entrance into Heaven, such things as are corporeal and material are wiped away by the Lord.
On a reasoning by some that sins are wiped out in the other life. General article.
